newsitem.title: USA: United States Filter signs $95 mln merger.
newsitem.headline: United States Filter signs $95 mln merger.

text.p: United States Filter Corp said Wednesday it agreed to buy the WaterPro Supplies Corp for about $95 million in stock.
United States Filter said it expected the deal to increase its earnings this year, but it did not say by how much.

In 1995, WaterPro reported revenues of roughly $300 million, up from $223 million in 1994 and $190 million in 1993. It is the largest national distributor of water and wastewater products for municipal water authorities, with 43 offices in the Midwest, Mountain and Mid-Atlantic regions.
U.S. Filter provides industrial and municipal water and wastewater treatment systems, products and services, with annual revenues of over $900 million. It has 170 sales and service offices worldwide.
U.S. Filter's stock was off 1/8 to 26-1/4 in early trading.
